name: Haiku growth at a reasonable price
strategy: Defensive value with secular growth hedges: healthcare and consumer staples quality focused on pricing power and dividend resilience in high-rate environment, energy exposure for yield, selective semiconductor equipment diversification
reassessment_note: Previous financial sector rotation thesis failed: Fed rate hike (Sept 16 to 3.75%-4%) materialized but flat yield curve (10Y at 5.23%) is compressing bank NIMs instead of expanding them. JPM -4.39%, GS -4.49%, XLF -3.06% all disappointed post-hike, invalidating the NIM expansion rationale. Pivoting entirely to defensive value with pricing power (healthcare, staples) that performs in flat/high-rate environment and energy for yield/dividends. Maintaining small crypto hedge and elevated cash (46%) for deployment when curve steepens or rates peak. ASML replaces semis for AI production cycle exposure without correlation to memory chip oversupply.

positions.thesis: UnitedHealth dominates US healthcare with integrated delivery network, strong pricing power, and secular aging demographics. Dividend grower resilient to rate environment. Earnings trajectory independent of monetary policy.
Pharma quality with GLP-1 tailwinds (obesity treatment cycle), stable dividend, diversified pipeline resilient to generics. Benefits from higher rates on cash yields while maintaining pricing power.
Diversified healthcare equipment and diagnostics play, secular demand for testing/monitoring, stable FCF generation, dividend story independent of rate regime.

Procter & Gamble staples dominance with pricing power to offset inflation and rate impacts, consistent dividend growth, defensive characteristics in uncertainty, brand moats justify premium valuation.
Coca-Cola staples defender with pricing power and brand strength, high dividend yield (3%+) attractive in 4% rate environment, international diversification reduces US rate sensitivity.
NextEra renewable utility benefits from energy transition, regulated utility model provides yield and inflation hedging, less sensitive to interest rate volatility than growth stocks.
Energy Select Sector SPDR provides exposure to high-dividend cycle (oil majors at 3-4% yields), benefits from structural energy transition delays and geopolitical premium, inflation hedge.
Semiconductor equipment supplier (lithography, inspection) plays AI production scaling without memory chip supply risk. Essential to any chip expansion cycle, diversification from memory-heavy plays.
Uncorrelated hedge to defensive portfolio, small allocation preserves upside in risk-on scenarios, positioned for longer-term cycle after recent consolidation in high-yield environment.
